Providing global connectivity
With 650 launched satellites in low-Earth orbit today, the world's largest and only satellite-to-mobile constellation is powering data, voice, video and messaging across six continents and will be accessible to more than 1.7 billion people.

Starlink Mobile's next-generation satellites will expand on these capabilities by providing broadband directly to mobile phones.
Data

Available on 40+ apps and on 100+ devices. Future service will offer video calls, streaming, emails and more.

Voice

Available with apps today. Future service will enable native calling.

Messaging

Powering millions of messages today. Future service will enable large files and videos.

Life-saving connectivity

Connectivity where you need it. Keeping you connected with data and messaging where terrestrial networks can't reach.

Wireless emergency alerts. Delivering public warning notifications to devices. Available in the United States, Canada and Japan with more countries coming soon.

Emergency response and relief. Enabling critical communications when traditional coverage isn't available.

A cellphone tower in space
Starlink Mobile works with existing LTE phones wherever you can see the sky. The satellites have an antenna that acts like a cellphone tower in space, the most advanced phased array antennas in the world that connect seamlessly over lasers to any point in the globe, allowing network integration similar to a standard roaming partner.
Future of Starlink Mobile
The next generation of Starlink Mobile satellites - V2 - will deliver full cellular coverage to places never thought possible via the highest performing satellite-to-mobile network ever built.

Driven by custom SpaceX-designed silicon and phased array antennas, the satellites will support thousands of spatial beams and higher bandwidth capability, enabling around 20x the throughput capability as compared to a first-generation satellite.

With Starlink Mobile V2 connectivity, mobile network operators can invest less in terrestrial networks while unlocking seamless service in remote areas and enabling total coverage everywhere for customers.
Increasing reliable connectivity
In most environments, Starlink Mobile V2 will enable full 5G cellular connectivity with a comparable experience to current terrestrial service.

In partnership with Mobile Network Operators, the V2 network will augment high capacity terrestrial 5G networks. Customers will be able to experience high-speed internet connectivity on their smartphones, with the ability to stream movies, make video calls, listen to podcasts, work remotely, and more—seamlessly transitioning between satellite and terrestrial networks without interruption or degradation in service.
